+# AI 写的小说 AI 味太重怎么办：去AI味的具体做法
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-contextual-help/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:2: trailing whitespace.
+
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-contextual-help/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:3: trailing whitespace.
+**一句话答案：** AI 味不是语法错误，是"过度圆滑、过度工整、解释太满"。去 AI 味要改的是读感，改最少的字，保留剧情功能。Oh Story（`zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode`，开源 MIT）把这件事做成了一个可重复的写作 lint：`/story-deslop`（`/去AI味`），先用脚本确定性地检出已知句式，再按 7 个 Gate 分级改写，删除比例有上限，改完出报告。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-contextual-help/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:4: trailing whitespace.

+这份文档说明 AI 味具体表现在哪里、怎么按等级处理，以及一个 skill 能自动化到什么程度。它不承诺任何 AI 检测器的分数。

+## 流程

+1. **确定性预检。** 输入是文件时，先跑 `node scripts/check-ai-patterns.js --check --fail-on=blocking <文件>`，只报告不修改。blocking 类别只限确定性的句式和标点问题（"不是……而是"对比、破折号、否定排比、预告式收尾等），其他提示按读感判断。

+2. **AI 味扫描报告。** 输出等级、主要问题，和一张"位置 / 类型 / 原文 / 问题"表。

+## 三条保护规则
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-contextual-help/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:54: trailing whitespace.

+这是 skill 和"让模型随便重写一遍"的核心区别：
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-contextual-help/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:56: trailing whitespace.

acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-contextual-help/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:57: trailing whitespace.
+- **改最少。** 能改一个词就不改一句，能删一句就不重写一段。人名、地名、数字、专有名词优先保留。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-contextual-help/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:58: trailing whitespace.
+- **删除有上限。** 轻度 ≤15%，中度 ≤25%，重度 ≤35%。不得整段删除正文；删除前要确认这段没有伏笔、钩子、角色特征、情节推进或因果锚点，会丢就改成"降 AI 重写"而不是删。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-contextual-help/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:59: trailing whitespace.
+- **只改怎么说，不改说什么。** 不新增原文没有的情节、设定、关系或时间线。原文的逻辑问题不是去 AI 味的活。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-contextual-help/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:60: trailing whitespace.

+## 关于 AI 检测器

+去 AI 味治读感，不治检测器。朱雀之类的外部检测只作自测参考；skill 不写"0% AI"，不注水、不故意错字、不打乱标点。如果你贴了检测报告，它只会把能对应到正文的问题转成具体修改点。签约平台的规则请看平台自己的说明，这个 skill 不替你做合规判断。

+### 每章字数不统一、字数对不上怎么办？

+## Why agents drift
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-contextual-help/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-reference-20261015/docs/keep-ai-novel-consistent-over-100-chapters.md:10: trailing whitespace.

+Every drift bug reduces to one question: what did the model see when it wrote this chapter? If it saw "the last few chapters", it forgot the clue planted in chapter 3. If it saw "a summary of the whole book", it treated a planned future event as something that already happened. A bigger context window does not fix this. A novel is longer than any window, and the more you stuff in, the less attention any single fact gets.
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-contextual-help/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-reference-20261015/docs/keep-ai-novel-consistent-over-100-chapters.md:12: trailing whitespace.

+Three design rules do the work:
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-contextual-help/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-reference-20261015/docs/keep-ai-novel-consistent-over-100-chapters.md:34: trailing whitespace.
+
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-contextual-help/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-reference-20261015/docs/keep-ai-novel-consistent-over-100-chapters.md:35: trailing whitespace.
+1. **One authority, everything else derived.** `_tracking-state.json` is the only writable truth. The state card, character snapshots, setup list and both timelines are generated from it deterministically. All writes go through `scripts/tracking_commit.py`; hand-editing derived files is forbidden. Two files can never disagree about where a character is.
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-contextual-help/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-reference-20261015/docs/keep-ai-novel-consistent-over-100-chapters.md:36: trailing whitespace.
+2. **Author truth and reader knowledge are separate timelines.** `时间线/作者真相.md` records what actually happened in the story. `时间线/读者已知.md` records what the reader has seen so far. When the model writes chapter 40 it can see who the murderer is, and also that the protagonist does not know yet, so it will not let a character blurt out the answer.
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-contextual-help/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-reference-20261015/docs/keep-ai-novel-consistent-over-100-chapters.md:37: trailing whitespace.
+3. **Per-chapter writes are capped deltas.** Each `逐章记录/第NNN章.md` targets ≤1536 bytes with a hard cap of 3072, and records only changes that affect later chapters. State does not grow linearly with chapter count. The context for chapter 300 is about the same size as for chapter 30.
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-contextual-help/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-reference-20261015/docs/keep-ai-novel-consistent-over-100-chapters.md:38: trailing whitespace.

+## What one chapter actually does

+From `story-long-write`'s single-chapter flow:
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-contextual-help/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-reference-20261015/docs/keep-ai-novel-consistent-over-100-chapters.md:42: trailing whitespace.

acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-contextual-help/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-reference-20261015/docs/keep-ai-novel-consistent-over-100-chapters.md:43: trailing whitespace.
+1. **Reference gate, read before write.** Load the chapter brief, the volume outline and the current tracking state, then record this round's constraints before writing: word range, must-happen, must-not-happen, time anchors, where the chapter stops, what new debt it opens. These project facts override any craft reference.
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-contextual-help/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-reference-20261015/docs/keep-ai-novel-consistent-over-100-chapters.md:44: trailing whitespace.
+2. **Load only what would otherwise be wrong.** For each character on stage, read `设定/角色/{name}.md` (stable characterization) and `追踪/角色状态/{name}.md` (current location, goal, relationships, what they know, open threads). "Xu Tang has an older brother" is characterization. "Xu Tang does not know the letter came from him" is state. Reading them separately is what stops the model from turning a fact into character knowledge.
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-contextual-help/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-reference-20261015/docs/keep-ai-novel-consistent-over-100-chapters.md:45: trailing whitespace.
+3. **Write the prose.**
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-contextual-help/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-reference-20261015/docs/keep-ai-novel-consistent-over-100-chapters.md:46: trailing whitespace.
+4. **Commit the delta.** `tracking_commit.py` records who learned what, which setup paid off, how far time moved. Derived files refresh.
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-contextual-help/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-reference-20261015/docs/keep-ai-novel-consistent-over-100-chapters.md:47: trailing whitespace.
+5. **Review.** `story-review` can spawn parallel reviewer agents, including a consistency checker, against the settings and tracking files. If the agents are not deployed it degrades to a single-thread review instead of skipping.
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-contextual-help/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-reference-20261015/docs/keep-ai-novel-consistent-over-100-chapters.md:48: trailing whitespace.
+
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-contextual-help/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-reference-20261015/docs/keep-ai-novel-consistent-over-100-chapters.md:49: trailing whitespace.
+This is why a three-chapter batch keeps working: each chapter starts from a fresh state card, not from an ever-growing chat transcript.

+## Limits
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-contextual-help/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-reference-20261015/docs/keep-ai-novel-consistent-over-100-chapters.md:56: trailing whitespace.

acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-contextual-help/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-reference-20261015/skills/story-long-write/references/workflow-volume.md:111: trailing whitespace.

+1. **选段（以剧情单元为单位）**：在主对标里圈出本卷要对标的剧情单元序列——选段单位就是拆文产出的剧情单元（`剧情/{剧情标题}.md`）。检索顺序：先读主对标 `剧情/README.md`「剧情单元清单」（有清单则一书一文件，按「类型 / 桥段标签」直接命中同类）；无清单则在 `剧情/*.md` 里按「类型」行（第一键，必填枚举）+「桥段标签 / 套路框架位置」行（第二键）圈同类；仍无命中回退按章节范围圈段，全程不阻塞。多对标时按 `cross-book-recall.md` 大纲预算从副对标补同类条目。读取必备权威文件 `剧情/节奏.md`（爆发密度 / 爽点循环）；缺失时先修复或重跑拆文 Stage 3，不从摘要猜测节奏。本卷对标几个剧情单元 ≈ 本卷字数 ÷ 1.5-3 万。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-contextual-help/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-reference-20261015/skills/story-long-write/references/workflow-volume.md:113: trailing whitespace.
+2. **标关键点**：看对标这几个剧情单元在 1/4、中点、3/4 各放了什么关键情节，判为逆转 / 转折 / 激励。摘要里「类型=转折点」的情节点 + 基调突变（如温馨→压抑）可用来定位关键点候选，再核对其因果作用；剧情单元的「结构分布」（铺垫/发展/高潮/收尾期）与「情节点索引」同为确定性锚。

+3. **换素材**：保留对标的情绪链和功能位，把对象、场景、事件全换成自己的，禁止照搬具体桥段。功能位清单取必备权威文件 `剧情/情绪模块.md` 的可替换项；缺失时先修复，不生成替代清单。

+4. **修正硬伤**：换素材前比对 `拆文报告.md`「不建议模仿」。对标若在某个关键点是弱处理（慢热留白、主角长期旁观等已知硬伤），迁移时要在该位置补一个缺的关键情节、或把后面的关键情节前置，而不是把弱处理一起抄过来——关键点该有的力度不能因为对标偷懒就跟着偷懒。

+**两列基准目录不同**：`Source path` 是包内来源，story-setup 内的路径以当前 `SKILL.md` 所在目录定位；`Target path` 相对用户项目根。执行每一行（以及各宿主部署算法里的每个递归复制步骤）之前，先把通配符具体化为单个源/目标，再用本 `SKILL.md` 同级的 `scripts/copy-path-safety.py` 检查。该脚本按 `Path.resolve` / `realpath` 语义跟随已有 symlink，并在两侧都存在时用 `samefile` 核对文件系统对象；**只转绝对路径或比较字符串不算检查完成**。读取其 JSON：`status: same` 时 no-op，禁止复制；仅 `copy_allowed: true` 时可以复制；`source_missing`、`unsafe_target_within_source` 或 `filesystem_identity_error` 必须停止该步骤并报告。无法运行脚本时只能用当前环境的文件系统 API 做完全相同的 canonical realpath、same-object 与 target-descendant 检查；无法确认就停止，不得尝试复制。OpenClaw / Reasonix / generic 的项目副本是整份 skill 拷贝，重跑时执行的就是项目里那份；Reasonix / Codex 还可能经 `.agents/skills → ../skills` symlink 加载，路径文本不同也可能指向同一目录，照字面复制会把目录嵌进自身并撑满磁盘。

+- **B 句式**：连续排比、刻意对称打散；**禁止高置信否定铺垫后再肯定翻转**——同句「不是A，(而)是B」「没有X没有Y只是Z」直接写肯定内容或改动作承担对比；跨段「不是A / 也不是B / 只是C」、`至于X不X，怎么X`、同动词 `不V A，不V B` 只作语义复核（advisory），重复细纲或拖慢画面时改，承担辩解、悬念排除或情绪递进时可保留（书级文风另有裁定按其执行）；普通名词不加引号强调（对话、逐字引用、场内载体原文除外）。

+- **G 去解释腔/上帝感**：先按本书叙述姿态判断，短篇例外见门禁 G；授权的有限全知、评论或旁人内心不因形式删除。删无功能的解释、未经授权的剧透、重复总结和空泛定性（之所以/原来/这意味着/她不知道的是/殊不知/多年以后）；承担锚点或情绪的压成角色白话；已有场内载体（手机/公告/屏幕）优先保留为角色看到的文本。

+# AI 写的小说 AI 味太重怎么办：去AI味的具体做法
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-final/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:2: trailing whitespace.
+
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-final/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:3: trailing whitespace.
+**一句话答案：** AI 味不是语法错误，是"过度圆滑、过度工整、解释太满"。去 AI 味要改的是读感，改最少的字，保留剧情功能。Oh Story（`zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode`，开源 MIT）把这件事做成了一个可重复的写作 lint：`/story-deslop`（`/去AI味`），先用脚本确定性地检出已知句式，再按 7 个 Gate 分级改写，删除比例有上限，改完出报告。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-final/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:4: trailing whitespace.
+
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-final/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:5: trailing whitespace.
+这份文档说明 AI 味具体表现在哪里、怎么按等级处理，以及一个 skill 能自动化到什么程度。它不承诺任何 AI 检测器的分数。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-final/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:6: trailing whitespace.

+## 流程

+1. **确定性预检。** 输入是文件时，先跑 `node scripts/check-ai-patterns.js --check --fail-on=blocking <文件>`，只报告不修改。blocking 类别只限确定性的句式和标点问题（"不是……而是"对比、破折号、否定排比、预告式收尾等），其他提示按读感判断。

+2. **AI 味扫描报告。** 输出等级、主要问题，和一张"位置 / 类型 / 原文 / 问题"表。

+3. **按改写顺序定点改写**（`references/anti-ai-writing.md`），只处理所选 Gate，按下面的先后排：

+## 三条保护规则
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-final/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:54: trailing whitespace.
+
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-final/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:55: trailing whitespace.
+这是 skill 和"让模型随便重写一遍"的核心区别：
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-final/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:56: trailing whitespace.
+
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-final/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:57: trailing whitespace.
+- **改最少。** 能改一个词就不改一句，能删一句就不重写一段。人名、地名、数字、专有名词优先保留。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-final/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:58: trailing whitespace.
+- **删除有上限。** 轻度 ≤15%，中度 ≤25%，重度 ≤35%。不得整段删除正文；删除前要确认这段没有伏笔、钩子、角色特征、情节推进或因果锚点，会丢就改成"降 AI 重写"而不是删。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-final/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:59: trailing whitespace.
+- **只改怎么说，不改说什么。** 不新增原文没有的情节、设定、关系或时间线。原文的逻辑问题不是去 AI 味的活。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-final/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:60: trailing whitespace.

+## 关于 AI 检测器
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-final/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:62: trailing whitespace.

+去 AI 味治读感，不治检测器。朱雀之类的外部检测只作自测参考；skill 不写"0% AI"，不注水、不故意错字、不打乱标点。如果你贴了检测报告，它只会把能对应到正文的问题转成具体修改点。签约平台的规则请看平台自己的说明，这个 skill 不替你做合规判断。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-final/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:64: trailing whitespace.

+### 每章字数不统一、字数对不上怎么办？

+从 v0.7.7 起，长篇正文只用一个机器统计的字数口径：每份细纲必须写明合法的「字数目标」，缺少时会停止而不是回退到 3000；欠字不会自动加戏，超字最多压缩一次。字数只由写作流程在交付前统一测量，写后 hook 不再提醒字数欠账。升级旧项目后重跑 `/story-setup` 并新开会话即可生效。

+## Why agents drift
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-final/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-reference-20261015/docs/keep-ai-novel-consistent-over-100-chapters.md:10: trailing whitespace.
+
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-final/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-reference-20261015/docs/keep-ai-novel-consistent-over-100-chapters.md:11: trailing whitespace.
+Every drift bug reduces to one question: what did the model see when it wrote this chapter? If it saw "the last few chapters", it forgot the clue planted in chapter 3. If it saw "a summary of the whole book", it treated a planned future event as something that already happened. A bigger context window does not fix this. A novel is longer than any window, and the more you stuff in, the less attention any single fact gets.
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-final/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-reference-20261015/docs/keep-ai-novel-consistent-over-100-chapters.md:12: trailing whitespace.

+So the fix is not memory. It is selection.

+Three design rules do the work:
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-final/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-reference-20261015/docs/keep-ai-novel-consistent-over-100-chapters.md:34: trailing whitespace.
+
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-final/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-reference-20261015/docs/keep-ai-novel-consistent-over-100-chapters.md:35: trailing whitespace.
+1. **One authority, everything else derived.** `_tracking-state.json` is the only writable truth. The state card, character snapshots, setup list and both timelines are generated from it deterministically. All writes go through `scripts/tracking_commit.py`; hand-editing derived files is forbidden. Two files can never disagree about where a character is.
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-final/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-reference-20261015/docs/keep-ai-novel-consistent-over-100-chapters.md:36: trailing whitespace.
+2. **Author truth and reader knowledge are separate timelines.** `时间线/作者真相.md` records what actually happened in the story. `时间线/读者已知.md` records what the reader has seen so far. When the model writes chapter 40 it can see who the murderer is, and also that the protagonist does not know yet, so it will not let a character blurt out the answer.
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-final/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-reference-20261015/docs/keep-ai-novel-consistent-over-100-chapters.md:37: trailing whitespace.
+3. **Per-chapter writes are capped deltas.** Each `逐章记录/第NNN章.md` targets ≤1536 bytes with a hard cap of 3072, and records only changes that affect later chapters. State does not grow linearly with chapter count. The context for chapter 300 is about the same size as for chapter 30.
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-final/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-reference-20261015/docs/keep-ai-novel-consistent-over-100-chapters.md:38: trailing whitespace.

+## What one chapter actually does
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-final/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-reference-20261015/docs/keep-ai-novel-consistent-over-100-chapters.md:40: trailing whitespace.

acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-final/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-reference-20261015/docs/keep-ai-novel-consistent-over-100-chapters.md:41: trailing whitespace.
+From `story-long-write`'s single-chapter flow:
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-final/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-reference-20261015/docs/keep-ai-novel-consistent-over-100-chapters.md:42: trailing whitespace.
+
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-final/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-reference-20261015/docs/keep-ai-novel-consistent-over-100-chapters.md:43: trailing whitespace.
+1. **Reference gate, read before write.** Load the chapter brief, the volume outline and the current tracking state, then record this round's constraints before writing: word range, must-happen, must-not-happen, time anchors, where the chapter stops, what new debt it opens. These project facts override any craft reference.
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-final/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-reference-20261015/docs/keep-ai-novel-consistent-over-100-chapters.md:44: trailing whitespace.
+2. **Load only what would otherwise be wrong.** For each character on stage, read `设定/角色/{name}.md` (stable characterization) and `追踪/角色状态/{name}.md` (current location, goal, relationships, what they know, open threads). "Xu Tang has an older brother" is characterization. "Xu Tang does not know the letter came from him" is state. Reading them separately is what stops the model from turning a fact into character knowledge.
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-final/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-reference-20261015/docs/keep-ai-novel-consistent-over-100-chapters.md:45: trailing whitespace.
+3. **Write the prose.**
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-final/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-reference-20261015/docs/keep-ai-novel-consistent-over-100-chapters.md:46: trailing whitespace.
+4. **Commit the delta.** `tracking_commit.py` records who learned what, which setup paid off, how far time moved. Derived files refresh.
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-final/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-reference-20261015/docs/keep-ai-novel-consistent-over-100-chapters.md:47: trailing whitespace.
+5. **Review.** `story-review` can spawn parallel reviewer agents, including a consistency checker, against the settings and tracking files. If the agents are not deployed it degrades to a single-thread review instead of skipping.
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-final/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-reference-20261015/docs/keep-ai-novel-consistent-over-100-chapters.md:48: trailing whitespace.

+- `chapter check`：重新读取当前正文与细纲目标，返回确定性长度状态、现有 blocking quality、`state_revision` 和当前可执行动作，不保存 approval。顶层 `status`：`ready`（可提交，exit 0）/ `needs_decision`（长度带外，按 `available_actions` 交作者，exit 0）/ `blocked`（有 blocking 正文问题，exit 1）/ `invalid`（正文为空等，exit 1）/ `tool_unavailable`（找不到 node 或检测脚本，见 `quality.tool_errors`，不是正文问题，exit 3）。参数错误或文件缺失输出 `story-chapter-error/v1`（`status: error`，exit 2）。`under` 不提供自动补写；`over` 额外返回一次净删型 `compress-once` 及回到生效区间所需的删除字数。`quality.semantic_advisories` 是语义类 advisory 条数（检测器标 `review: mechanical` 的不计）。

+**两列基准目录不同**：`Source path` 是包内来源，story-setup 内的路径以当前 `SKILL.md` 所在目录定位；`Target path` 相对用户项目根。执行每一行（以及各宿主部署算法里的每个递归复制步骤）之前，先把通配符具体化为单个源/目标，再用本 `SKILL.md` 同级的 `scripts/copy-path-safety.py` 检查。该脚本按 `Path.resolve` / `realpath` 语义跟随已有 symlink，并在两侧都存在时用 `samefile` 核对文件系统对象；**只转绝对路径或比较字符串不算检查完成**。读取其 JSON：`status: same` 时 no-op，禁止复制；仅 `copy_allowed: true` 时可以复制；`source_missing`、`unsafe_target_within_source` 或 `filesystem_identity_error` 必须停止该步骤并报告。无法运行脚本时只能用当前环境的文件系统 API 做完全相同的 canonical realpath、same-object 与 target-descendant 检查；无法确认就停止，不得尝试复制。OpenClaw / Reasonix / generic 的项目副本是整份 skill 拷贝，重跑时执行的就是项目里那份；Reasonix / Codex 还可能经 `.agents/skills → ../skills` symlink 加载，路径文本不同也可能指向同一目录，照字面复制会把目录嵌进自身并撑满磁盘。

+# AI 写的小说 AI 味太重怎么办：去AI味的具体做法
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-guarded/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:2: trailing whitespace.

+**一句话答案：** AI 味不是语法错误，是"过度圆滑、过度工整、解释太满"。去 AI 味要改的是读感，改最少的字，保留剧情功能。Oh Story（`zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode`，开源 MIT）把这件事做成了一个可重复的写作 lint：`/story-deslop`（`/去AI味`），先用脚本确定性地检出已知句式，再按 7 个 Gate 分级改写，删除比例有上限，改完出报告。

+这份文档说明 AI 味具体表现在哪里、怎么按等级处理，以及一个 skill 能自动化到什么程度。它不承诺任何 AI 检测器的分数。

+## 三条保护规则

+这是 skill 和"让模型随便重写一遍"的核心区别：
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-guarded/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:56: trailing whitespace.

+- **改最少。** 能改一个词就不改一句，能删一句就不重写一段。人名、地名、数字、专有名词优先保留。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-guarded/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:58: trailing whitespace.
+- **删除有上限。** 轻度 ≤15%，中度 ≤25%，重度 ≤35%。不得整段删除正文；删除前要确认这段没有伏笔、钩子、角色特征、情节推进或因果锚点，会丢就改成"降 AI 重写"而不是删。

+### 每章字数不统一、字数对不上怎么办？
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-guarded/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-reference-20261015/README.md:349: trailing whitespace.
+

+从 v0.7.7 起，长篇正文只用一个机器统计的字数口径：每份细纲必须写明合法的「字数目标」，缺少时会停止而不是回退到 3000；欠字不会自动加戏，超字最多压缩一次。字数只由写作流程在交付前统一测量，写后 hook 不再提醒字数欠账。升级旧项目后重跑 `/story-setup` 并新开会话即可生效。

+# How to keep an AI writing agent from breaking character over 100+ chapters
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-guarded/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-reference-20261015/docs/keep-ai-novel-consistent-over-100-chapters.md:2: trailing whitespace.

+## Why agents drift
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-guarded/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-reference-20261015/docs/keep-ai-novel-consistent-over-100-chapters.md:10: trailing whitespace.
+
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-guarded/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-reference-20261015/docs/keep-ai-novel-consistent-over-100-chapters.md:11: trailing whitespace.
+Every drift bug reduces to one question: what did the model see when it wrote this chapter? If it saw "the last few chapters", it forgot the clue planted in chapter 3. If it saw "a summary of the whole book", it treated a planned future event as something that already happened. A bigger context window does not fix this. A novel is longer than any window, and the more you stuff in, the less attention any single fact gets.
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-guarded/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-reference-20261015/docs/keep-ai-novel-consistent-over-100-chapters.md:12: trailing whitespace.

+So the fix is not memory. It is selection.

+Three design rules do the work:
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-guarded/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-reference-20261015/docs/keep-ai-novel-consistent-over-100-chapters.md:34: trailing whitespace.
+
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-guarded/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-reference-20261015/docs/keep-ai-novel-consistent-over-100-chapters.md:35: trailing whitespace.
+1. **One authority, everything else derived.** `_tracking-state.json` is the only writable truth. The state card, character snapshots, setup list and both timelines are generated from it deterministically. All writes go through `scripts/tracking_commit.py`; hand-editing derived files is forbidden. Two files can never disagree about where a character is.
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-guarded/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-reference-20261015/docs/keep-ai-novel-consistent-over-100-chapters.md:36: trailing whitespace.
+2. **Author truth and reader knowledge are separate timelines.** `时间线/作者真相.md` records what actually happened in the story. `时间线/读者已知.md` records what the reader has seen so far. When the model writes chapter 40 it can see who the murderer is, and also that the protagonist does not know yet, so it will not let a character blurt out the answer.
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-guarded/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-reference-20261015/docs/keep-ai-novel-consistent-over-100-chapters.md:37: trailing whitespace.
+3. **Per-chapter writes are capped deltas.** Each `逐章记录/第NNN章.md` targets ≤1536 bytes with a hard cap of 3072, and records only changes that affect later chapters. State does not grow linearly with chapter count. The context for chapter 300 is about the same size as for chapter 30.
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-guarded/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-reference-20261015/docs/keep-ai-novel-consistent-over-100-chapters.md:38: trailing whitespace.

+## What one chapter actually does
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-guarded/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-reference-20261015/docs/keep-ai-novel-consistent-over-100-chapters.md:40: trailing whitespace.

+From `story-long-write`'s single-chapter flow:
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-guarded/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-reference-20261015/docs/keep-ai-novel-consistent-over-100-chapters.md:42: trailing whitespace.
+
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-guarded/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-reference-20261015/docs/keep-ai-novel-consistent-over-100-chapters.md:43: trailing whitespace.
+1. **Reference gate, read before write.** Load the chapter brief, the volume outline and the current tracking state, then record this round's constraints before writing: word range, must-happen, must-not-happen, time anchors, where the chapter stops, what new debt it opens. These project facts override any craft reference.
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-guarded/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-reference-20261015/docs/keep-ai-novel-consistent-over-100-chapters.md:44: trailing whitespace.
+2. **Load only what would otherwise be wrong.** For each character on stage, read `设定/角色/{name}.md` (stable characterization) and `追踪/角色状态/{name}.md` (current location, goal, relationships, what they know, open threads). "Xu Tang has an older brother" is characterization. "Xu Tang does not know the letter came from him" is state. Reading them separately is what stops the model from turning a fact into character knowledge.
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-guarded/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-reference-20261015/docs/keep-ai-novel-consistent-over-100-chapters.md:45: trailing whitespace.
+3. **Write the prose.**
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-guarded/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-reference-20261015/docs/keep-ai-novel-consistent-over-100-chapters.md:46: trailing whitespace.
+4. **Commit the delta.** `tracking_commit.py` records who learned what, which setup paid off, how far time moved. Derived files refresh.
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-guarded/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-reference-20261015/docs/keep-ai-novel-consistent-over-100-chapters.md:47: trailing whitespace.
+5. **Review.** `story-review` can spawn parallel reviewer agents, including a consistency checker, against the settings and tracking files. If the agents are not deployed it degrades to a single-thread review instead of skipping.
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-guarded/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-reference-20261015/docs/keep-ai-novel-consistent-over-100-chapters.md:48: trailing whitespace.
+

+This is why a three-chapter batch keeps working: each chapter starts from a fresh state card, not from an ever-growing chat transcript.

+事务 JSON 是临时输入，不是项目产物：只写在书目录 `.story/work/` 下（逐章事务放 `.story/work/第NNN章/tracking.json`），不写系统 `/tmp`、书根、`大纲/` 或 `正文/`；成功前必须保留，提交成功后即可删除（`storyctl.py chapter commit` / `accept-current-length` 成功时自动删除该章目录；直接调用 `tracking_commit.py commit` 时由调用方删除。已有字数记录的章节正文或目标改过后，`tracking_commit.py commit` 拒绝修订事务，须走 `storyctl.py chapter commit`）——之后 `check` 失败按下文提交 `mode=revision` 新事务修复，不需要原事务。若文件写入失败，`_tracking-state.json` 尚未推进；修正环境后直接重跑**同一份** `commit`。append 重跑只接受内容完全相同的既有逐章记录，不维护 `dirty/pending/repair` 状态机。

+校验失败与写入失败处理方式不同：校验失败（字段非法、退役结构、容量超限）要按报错改事务本身，重跑同一份结果不变。派生视图被手改或外部改动导致 `check` 报 `derived view differs from _tracking-state.json` 时，重新提交**该章**的 `mode=revision` 事务让工具整份重建，`expected_state_revision` 取 `追踪/_tracking-state.json` 的 `state_revision` 字段——`check` 失败时只往 stderr 打 ERROR，不输出 JSON；不手改派生文件，也不删 `_tracking-state.json` 重来。手写出的逐章记录会让同章 `append` 永久报 `chapter delta N already exists with different content`——删掉那个手写文件后重跑原事务即可。

+### 对标节奏迁移（卷纲定稿前做一次，无对标书可跳过）
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-guarded/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-reference-20261015/skills/story-long-write/references/workflow-volume.md:111: trailing whitespace.

+1. **选段（以剧情单元为单位）**：在主对标里圈出本卷要对标的剧情单元序列——选段单位就是拆文产出的剧情单元（`剧情/{剧情标题}.md`）。检索顺序：先读主对标 `剧情/README.md`「剧情单元清单」（有清单则一书一文件，按「类型 / 桥段标签」直接命中同类）；无清单则在 `剧情/*.md` 里按「类型」行（第一键，必填枚举）+「桥段标签 / 套路框架位置」行（第二键）圈同类；仍无命中回退按章节范围圈段，全程不阻塞。多对标时按 `cross-book-recall.md` 大纲预算从副对标补同类条目。读取必备权威文件 `剧情/节奏.md`（爆发密度 / 爽点循环）；缺失时先修复或重跑拆文 Stage 3，不从摘要猜测节奏。本卷对标几个剧情单元 ≈ 本卷字数 ÷ 1.5-3 万。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-guarded/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-reference-20261015/skills/story-long-write/references/workflow-volume.md:113: trailing whitespace.
+2. **标关键点**：看对标这几个剧情单元在 1/4、中点、3/4 各放了什么关键情节，判为逆转 / 转折 / 激励。摘要里「类型=转折点」的情节点 + 基调突变（如温馨→压抑）可用来定位关键点候选，再核对其因果作用；剧情单元的「结构分布」（铺垫/发展/高潮/收尾期）与「情节点索引」同为确定性锚。

+3. **换素材**：保留对标的情绪链和功能位，把对象、场景、事件全换成自己的，禁止照搬具体桥段。功能位清单取必备权威文件 `剧情/情绪模块.md` 的可替换项；缺失时先修复，不生成替代清单。

+5. **排章 + 落卷纲**：把换好（并修正）的关键情节落到本卷相同相对位置——这里的 1/4·中点·3/4 是**卷尺度**（1/4≈总章×0.25、中点×0.5、3/4×0.75）；卷里有几个剧情单元时，每个剧情单元内部另有自己的铺垫→逆转→收尾，别和卷尺度的关键点混为一谈。关键点之间用普通推进章过渡，每个关键点之后按需插一章呼吸 / 关系章；写进卷纲「对标结构坐标」与情绪弧线的章节定位列，细纲承接时每章标章节定位。同时把选中的剧情单元以 {书名}《剧情标题》写入剧情单元卡「对标剧情参照」。

+**两列基准目录不同**：`Source path` 是包内来源，story-setup 内的路径以当前 `SKILL.md` 所在目录定位；`Target path` 相对用户项目根。执行每一行（以及各宿主部署算法里的每个递归复制步骤）之前，先把通配符具体化为单个源/目标，再用本 `SKILL.md` 同级的 `scripts/copy-path-safety.py` 检查。该脚本按 `Path.resolve` / `realpath` 语义跟随已有 symlink，并在两侧都存在时用 `samefile` 核对文件系统对象；**只转绝对路径或比较字符串不算检查完成**。读取其 JSON：`status: same` 时 no-op，禁止复制；仅 `copy_allowed: true` 时可以复制；`source_missing`、`unsafe_target_within_source` 或 `filesystem_identity_error` 必须停止该步骤并报告。无法运行脚本时只能用当前环境的文件系统 API 做完全相同的 canonical realpath、same-object 与 target-descendant 检查；无法确认就停止，不得尝试复制。OpenClaw / Reasonix / generic 的项目副本是整份 skill 拷贝，重跑时执行的就是项目里那份；Reasonix / Codex 还可能经 `.agents/skills → ../skills` symlink 加载，路径文本不同也可能指向同一目录，照字面复制会把目录嵌进自身并撑满磁盘。

+1. **先定情绪，再定故事**。动笔前必须确定目标情绪（意难平/反转震撼/爽感释放/治愈温暖/细思极恐/共鸣感动），所有内容为这个情绪服务。

+2. **一个核心支点撑一篇**。反转型围绕一次主揭示蓄力；无反转型围绕报应兑现或甜度递进积累期待。不多线、不铺世界观。

+3. **每句话必须有用**。不推动剧情、不铺垫反转、不推高情绪的句子 → 删。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/candidate-guarded/ai-writer-0.9.0/vendor/oh-story-reference-20261015/skills/story-short-write/SKILL.md:41: trailing whitespace.
+4. **开头 3 句定生死，结尾定传播**。开头必须包含钩子，结尾必须有余韵。

+5. **默认第一人称**，用亲历视角建立代入感。当前请求、本篇文风或题材需要第三人称时按其执行。

+# AI 写的小说 AI 味太重怎么办：去AI味的具体做法
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-after/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:2: trailing whitespace.
+
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-after/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:3: trailing whitespace.
+**一句话答案：** AI 味不是语法错误，是"过度圆滑、过度工整、解释太满"。去 AI 味要改的是读感，改最少的字，保留剧情功能。Oh Story（`zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode`，开源 MIT）把这件事做成了一个可重复的写作 lint：`/story-deslop`（`/去AI味`），先用脚本确定性地检出已知句式，再按 7 个 Gate 分级改写，删除比例有上限，改完出报告。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-after/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:4: trailing whitespace.
+
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-after/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:5: trailing whitespace.
+这份文档说明 AI 味具体表现在哪里、怎么按等级处理，以及一个 skill 能自动化到什么程度。它不承诺任何 AI 检测器的分数。

+## 流程
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-after/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:44: trailing whitespace.
+
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-after/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:45: trailing whitespace.
+1. **确定性预检。** 输入是文件时，先跑 `node scripts/check-ai-patterns.js --check --fail-on=blocking <文件>`，只报告不修改。blocking 类别只限确定性的句式和标点问题（"不是……而是"对比、破折号、否定排比、预告式收尾等），其他提示按读感判断。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-after/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:46: trailing whitespace.
+2. **AI 味扫描报告。** 输出等级、主要问题，和一张"位置 / 类型 / 原文 / 问题"表。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-after/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:47: trailing whitespace.
+3. **按改写顺序定点改写**（`references/anti-ai-writing.md`），只处理所选 Gate，按下面的先后排：
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-after/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:48: trailing whitespace.
+   - 先去泛化：禁用词、抽象情绪、工整对仗、解释腔。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-after/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:49: trailing whitespace.
+   - 再去书面化：书面腔用词、句式套路。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-after/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:50: trailing whitespace.
+   - 最后回自然感：长短节奏、对话差异化、结尾去升华、补具体感官细节。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-after/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:51: trailing whitespace.
+4. **改后报告**，标出 `[需复核]` 的位置。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-after/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:52: trailing whitespace.
+
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-after/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:53: trailing whitespace.
+## 三条保护规则
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-after/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:54: trailing whitespace.
+
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-after/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:55: trailing whitespace.
+这是 skill 和"让模型随便重写一遍"的核心区别：
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-after/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:56: trailing whitespace.
+
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-after/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:57: trailing whitespace.
+- **改最少。** 能改一个词就不改一句，能删一句就不重写一段。人名、地名、数字、专有名词优先保留。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-after/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:58: trailing whitespace.
+- **删除有上限。** 轻度 ≤15%，中度 ≤25%，重度 ≤35%。不得整段删除正文；删除前要确认这段没有伏笔、钩子、角色特征、情节推进或因果锚点，会丢就改成"降 AI 重写"而不是删。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-after/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:59: trailing whitespace.
+- **只改怎么说，不改说什么。** 不新增原文没有的情节、设定、关系或时间线。原文的逻辑问题不是去 AI 味的活。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-after/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:60: trailing whitespace.
+
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-after/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:61: trailing whitespace.
+## 关于 AI 检测器
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-after/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:62: trailing whitespace.
+
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-after/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:63: trailing whitespace.
+去 AI 味治读感，不治检测器。朱雀之类的外部检测只作自测参考；skill 不写"0% AI"，不注水、不故意错字、不打乱标点。如果你贴了检测报告，它只会把能对应到正文的问题转成具体修改点。签约平台的规则请看平台自己的说明，这个 skill 不替你做合规判断。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-after/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:64: trailing whitespace.

+**一句话答案：** AI 味不是语法错误，是"过度圆滑、过度工整、解释太满"。去 AI 味要改的是读感，改最少的字，保留剧情功能。Oh Story（`zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode`，开源 MIT）把这件事做成了一个可重复的写作 lint：`/story-deslop`（`/去AI味`），先用脚本确定性地检出已知句式，再按 7 个 Gate 分级改写，删除比例有上限，改完出报告。

+## 流程
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-after/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:44: trailing whitespace.

acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-after/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:45: trailing whitespace.
+1. **确定性预检。** 输入是文件时，先跑 `node scripts/check-ai-patterns.js --check --fail-on=blocking <文件>`，只报告不修改。blocking 类别只限确定性的句式和标点问题（"不是……而是"对比、破折号、否定排比、预告式收尾等），其他提示按读感判断。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-after/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:46: trailing whitespace.
+2. **AI 味扫描报告。** 输出等级、主要问题，和一张"位置 / 类型 / 原文 / 问题"表。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-after/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:47: trailing whitespace.
+3. **按改写顺序定点改写**（`references/anti-ai-writing.md`），只处理所选 Gate，按下面的先后排：
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-after/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:48: trailing whitespace.
+   - 先去泛化：禁用词、抽象情绪、工整对仗、解释腔。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-after/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:49: trailing whitespace.
+   - 再去书面化：书面腔用词、句式套路。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-after/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:50: trailing whitespace.
+   - 最后回自然感：长短节奏、对话差异化、结尾去升华、补具体感官细节。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-after/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:51: trailing whitespace.
+4. **改后报告**，标出 `[需复核]` 的位置。

+## 三条保护规则
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-after/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:54: trailing whitespace.
+
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-after/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:55: trailing whitespace.
+这是 skill 和"让模型随便重写一遍"的核心区别：
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-after/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:56: trailing whitespace.
+
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-after/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:57: trailing whitespace.
+- **改最少。** 能改一个词就不改一句，能删一句就不重写一段。人名、地名、数字、专有名词优先保留。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-after/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:58: trailing whitespace.
+- **删除有上限。** 轻度 ≤15%，中度 ≤25%，重度 ≤35%。不得整段删除正文；删除前要确认这段没有伏笔、钩子、角色特征、情节推进或因果锚点，会丢就改成"降 AI 重写"而不是删。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-after/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:59: trailing whitespace.
+- **只改怎么说，不改说什么。** 不新增原文没有的情节、设定、关系或时间线。原文的逻辑问题不是去 AI 味的活。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-after/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:60: trailing whitespace.
+
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-after/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:61: trailing whitespace.
+## 关于 AI 检测器
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-after/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:62: trailing whitespace.
+
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-after/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:63: trailing whitespace.
+去 AI 味治读感，不治检测器。朱雀之类的外部检测只作自测参考；skill 不写"0% AI"，不注水、不故意错字、不打乱标点。如果你贴了检测报告，它只会把能对应到正文的问题转成具体修改点。签约平台的规则请看平台自己的说明，这个 skill 不替你做合规判断。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-after/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:64: trailing whitespace.

+## Anti-AI Psychology Checklist
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-before/.agents/skills/writer-review/references/psychology-readability.md:90: trailing whitespace.
+
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-before/.agents/skills/writer-review/references/psychology-readability.md:91: trailing whitespace.
+Flag a scene when any of these appear in a major psychological node:
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-before/.agents/skills/writer-review/references/psychology-readability.md:92: trailing whitespace.
+
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-before/.agents/skills/writer-review/references/psychology-readability.md:93: trailing whitespace.
+- The character names the emotion but the reader cannot feel how it formed.
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-before/.agents/skills/writer-review/references/psychology-readability.md:94: trailing whitespace.
+- The character processes danger in a perfectly linear sequence: observe, infer, decide, with no bodily lag or emotional interference.
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-before/.agents/skills/writer-review/references/psychology-readability.md:95: trailing whitespace.
+- The reaction mainly explains plot stakes to the reader instead of showing what the character can bear, avoid, misunderstand, or choose.
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-before/.agents/skills/writer-review/references/psychology-readability.md:96: trailing whitespace.
+- Every character has the same calm, compressed, analytical response style.
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-before/.agents/skills/writer-review/references/psychology-readability.md:97: trailing whitespace.
+- The scene uses elegant abstract lines where a human would first have messy sensory, bodily, or practical reactions.
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-before/.agents/skills/writer-review/references/psychology-readability.md:98: trailing whitespace.
+- The character instantly accepts an impossible event, betrayal, death, or institutional threat without testing, denial, stunned silence, or partial misreading.
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-before/.agents/skills/writer-review/references/psychology-readability.md:99: trailing whitespace.
+- A supposedly devastating moment leaves no residue in later movement, speech, trust, sleep, appetite, attention, or decision.
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-before/.agents/skills/writer-review/references/psychology-readability.md:100: trailing whitespace.
+
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-before/.agents/skills/writer-review/references/psychology-readability.md:101: trailing whitespace.
+For publication review, a major node with AI-like psychology is a hard blocker even if the plot logic is sound. Score it below the publication line until the scene is rebuilt as lived human experience.
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-before/.agents/skills/writer-review/references/psychology-readability.md:102: trailing whitespace.
+
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-before/.agents/skills/writer-review/references/psychology-readability.md:118: trailing whitespace.
+If a scene's emotional truth depends on a supporting character, that character must not be reduced to a reaction button for the protagonist.
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-before/.agents/skills/writer-review/references/psychology-readability.md:119: trailing whitespace.
+
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-before/.agents/skills/writer-review/references/psychology-readability.md:143: trailing whitespace.

+Hard blocker: if a chapter's important psychological moment could belong to any character after changing the name, or if it reads like one or two explanatory sentences added after the plot was already built, the chapter is below the publication line until that node is rebuilt as character-bound lived experience.

+# AI 写的小说 AI 味太重怎么办：去AI味的具体做法
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-before/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:2: trailing whitespace.
+
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-before/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:3: trailing whitespace.
+**一句话答案：** AI 味不是语法错误，是"过度圆滑、过度工整、解释太满"。去 AI 味要改的是读感，改最少的字，保留剧情功能。Oh Story（`zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode`，开源 MIT）把这件事做成了一个可重复的写作 lint：`/story-deslop`（`/去AI味`），先用脚本确定性地检出已知句式，再按 7 个 Gate 分级改写，删除比例有上限，改完出报告。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-before/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:4: trailing whitespace.
+
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-before/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:5: trailing whitespace.
+这份文档说明 AI 味具体表现在哪里、怎么按等级处理，以及一个 skill 能自动化到什么程度。它不承诺任何 AI 检测器的分数。

+## 流程
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-before/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:44: trailing whitespace.
+

+1. **确定性预检。** 输入是文件时，先跑 `node scripts/check-ai-patterns.js --check --fail-on=blocking <文件>`，只报告不修改。blocking 类别只限确定性的句式和标点问题（"不是……而是"对比、破折号、否定排比、预告式收尾等），其他提示按读感判断。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-before/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:46: trailing whitespace.
+2. **AI 味扫描报告。** 输出等级、主要问题，和一张"位置 / 类型 / 原文 / 问题"表。

+   - 先去泛化：禁用词、抽象情绪、工整对仗、解释腔。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-before/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:49: trailing whitespace.
+   - 再去书面化：书面腔用词、句式套路。

+## 三条保护规则
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-before/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:54: trailing whitespace.
+
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-before/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:55: trailing whitespace.
+这是 skill 和"让模型随便重写一遍"的核心区别：
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-before/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:56: trailing whitespace.
+
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-before/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:57: trailing whitespace.
+- **改最少。** 能改一个词就不改一句，能删一句就不重写一段。人名、地名、数字、专有名词优先保留。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-before/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:58: trailing whitespace.
+- **删除有上限。** 轻度 ≤15%，中度 ≤25%，重度 ≤35%。不得整段删除正文；删除前要确认这段没有伏笔、钩子、角色特征、情节推进或因果锚点，会丢就改成"降 AI 重写"而不是删。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-before/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:59: trailing whitespace.
+- **只改怎么说，不改说什么。** 不新增原文没有的情节、设定、关系或时间线。原文的逻辑问题不是去 AI 味的活。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-before/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:60: trailing whitespace.

+## 关于 AI 检测器
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-before/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:62: trailing whitespace.
+

+去 AI 味治读感，不治检测器。朱雀之类的外部检测只作自测参考；skill 不写"0% AI"，不注水、不故意错字、不打乱标点。如果你贴了检测报告，它只会把能对应到正文的问题转成具体修改点。签约平台的规则请看平台自己的说明，这个 skill 不替你做合规判断。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-before/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:64: trailing whitespace.

+# AI 写的小说 AI 味太重怎么办：去AI味的具体做法
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-before/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:2: trailing whitespace.
+
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-before/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:3: trailing whitespace.
+**一句话答案：** AI 味不是语法错误，是"过度圆滑、过度工整、解释太满"。去 AI 味要改的是读感，改最少的字，保留剧情功能。Oh Story（`zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode`，开源 MIT）把这件事做成了一个可重复的写作 lint：`/story-deslop`（`/去AI味`），先用脚本确定性地检出已知句式，再按 7 个 Gate 分级改写，删除比例有上限，改完出报告。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-before/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:4: trailing whitespace.
+
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-before/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:5: trailing whitespace.
+这份文档说明 AI 味具体表现在哪里、怎么按等级处理，以及一个 skill 能自动化到什么程度。它不承诺任何 AI 检测器的分数。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-before/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:6: trailing whitespace.

+## 流程
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-before/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:44: trailing whitespace.

+1. **确定性预检。** 输入是文件时，先跑 `node scripts/check-ai-patterns.js --check --fail-on=blocking <文件>`，只报告不修改。blocking 类别只限确定性的句式和标点问题（"不是……而是"对比、破折号、否定排比、预告式收尾等），其他提示按读感判断。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-before/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:46: trailing whitespace.
+2. **AI 味扫描报告。** 输出等级、主要问题，和一张"位置 / 类型 / 原文 / 问题"表。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-before/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:47: trailing whitespace.
+3. **按改写顺序定点改写**（`references/anti-ai-writing.md`），只处理所选 Gate，按下面的先后排：
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-before/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:48: trailing whitespace.
+   - 先去泛化：禁用词、抽象情绪、工整对仗、解释腔。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-before/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:49: trailing whitespace.
+   - 再去书面化：书面腔用词、句式套路。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-before/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:50: trailing whitespace.
+   - 最后回自然感：长短节奏、对话差异化、结尾去升华、补具体感官细节。

+4. **改后报告**，标出 `[需复核]` 的位置。

+## 三条保护规则
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-before/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:54: trailing whitespace.
+
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-before/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:55: trailing whitespace.
+这是 skill 和"让模型随便重写一遍"的核心区别：
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-before/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:56: trailing whitespace.
+
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-before/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:57: trailing whitespace.
+- **改最少。** 能改一个词就不改一句，能删一句就不重写一段。人名、地名、数字、专有名词优先保留。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-before/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:58: trailing whitespace.
+- **删除有上限。** 轻度 ≤15%，中度 ≤25%，重度 ≤35%。不得整段删除正文；删除前要确认这段没有伏笔、钩子、角色特征、情节推进或因果锚点，会丢就改成"降 AI 重写"而不是删。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-before/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:59: trailing whitespace.
+- **只改怎么说，不改说什么。** 不新增原文没有的情节、设定、关系或时间线。原文的逻辑问题不是去 AI 味的活。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-before/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:60: trailing whitespace.

+## 关于 AI 检测器
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-before/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:62: trailing whitespace.

acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-before/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:63: trailing whitespace.
+去 AI 味治读感，不治检测器。朱雀之类的外部检测只作自测参考；skill 不写"0% AI"，不注水、不故意错字、不打乱标点。如果你贴了检测报告，它只会把能对应到正文的问题转成具体修改点。签约平台的规则请看平台自己的说明，这个 skill 不替你做合规判断。

+## Anti-AI Psychology Checklist

+# AI 写的小说 AI 味太重怎么办：去AI味的具体做法
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-legacy/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:2: trailing whitespace.
+
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-legacy/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:3: trailing whitespace.
+**一句话答案：** AI 味不是语法错误，是"过度圆滑、过度工整、解释太满"。去 AI 味要改的是读感，改最少的字，保留剧情功能。Oh Story（`zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode`，开源 MIT）把这件事做成了一个可重复的写作 lint：`/story-deslop`（`/去AI味`），先用脚本确定性地检出已知句式，再按 7 个 Gate 分级改写，删除比例有上限，改完出报告。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-legacy/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:4: trailing whitespace.
+

+这份文档说明 AI 味具体表现在哪里、怎么按等级处理，以及一个 skill 能自动化到什么程度。它不承诺任何 AI 检测器的分数。

+## 流程
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-legacy/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:44: trailing whitespace.
+
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-legacy/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:45: trailing whitespace.
+1. **确定性预检。** 输入是文件时，先跑 `node scripts/check-ai-patterns.js --check --fail-on=blocking <文件>`，只报告不修改。blocking 类别只限确定性的句式和标点问题（"不是……而是"对比、破折号、否定排比、预告式收尾等），其他提示按读感判断。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-legacy/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:46: trailing whitespace.
+2. **AI 味扫描报告。** 输出等级、主要问题，和一张"位置 / 类型 / 原文 / 问题"表。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-legacy/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:47: trailing whitespace.
+3. **按改写顺序定点改写**（`references/anti-ai-writing.md`），只处理所选 Gate，按下面的先后排：
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-legacy/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:48: trailing whitespace.
+   - 先去泛化：禁用词、抽象情绪、工整对仗、解释腔。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-legacy/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:49: trailing whitespace.
+   - 再去书面化：书面腔用词、句式套路。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-legacy/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:50: trailing whitespace.
+   - 最后回自然感：长短节奏、对话差异化、结尾去升华、补具体感官细节。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-legacy/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:51: trailing whitespace.
+4. **改后报告**，标出 `[需复核]` 的位置。

+## 三条保护规则
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-legacy/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:54: trailing whitespace.
+
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-legacy/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:55: trailing whitespace.
+这是 skill 和"让模型随便重写一遍"的核心区别：
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-legacy/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:56: trailing whitespace.
+
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-legacy/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:57: trailing whitespace.
+- **改最少。** 能改一个词就不改一句，能删一句就不重写一段。人名、地名、数字、专有名词优先保留。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-legacy/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:58: trailing whitespace.
+- **删除有上限。** 轻度 ≤15%，中度 ≤25%，重度 ≤35%。不得整段删除正文；删除前要确认这段没有伏笔、钩子、角色特征、情节推进或因果锚点，会丢就改成"降 AI 重写"而不是删。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-legacy/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:59: trailing whitespace.
+- **只改怎么说，不改说什么。** 不新增原文没有的情节、设定、关系或时间线。原文的逻辑问题不是去 AI 味的活。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-legacy/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:60: trailing whitespace.
+
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-legacy/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:61: trailing whitespace.
+## 关于 AI 检测器
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-legacy/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:62: trailing whitespace.
+
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-legacy/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:63: trailing whitespace.
+去 AI 味治读感，不治检测器。朱雀之类的外部检测只作自测参考；skill 不写"0% AI"，不注水、不故意错字、不打乱标点。如果你贴了检测报告，它只会把能对应到正文的问题转成具体修改点。签约平台的规则请看平台自己的说明，这个 skill 不替你做合规判断。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-legacy/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:64: trailing whitespace.

+# AI 写的小说 AI 味太重怎么办：去AI味的具体做法
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-legacy/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:2: trailing whitespace.
+
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-legacy/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:3: trailing whitespace.
+**一句话答案：** AI 味不是语法错误，是"过度圆滑、过度工整、解释太满"。去 AI 味要改的是读感，改最少的字，保留剧情功能。Oh Story（`zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode`，开源 MIT）把这件事做成了一个可重复的写作 lint：`/story-deslop`（`/去AI味`），先用脚本确定性地检出已知句式，再按 7 个 Gate 分级改写，删除比例有上限，改完出报告。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-legacy/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:4: trailing whitespace.
+
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-legacy/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:5: trailing whitespace.
+这份文档说明 AI 味具体表现在哪里、怎么按等级处理，以及一个 skill 能自动化到什么程度。它不承诺任何 AI 检测器的分数。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-legacy/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:6: trailing whitespace.

+## 流程

+1. **确定性预检。** 输入是文件时，先跑 `node scripts/check-ai-patterns.js --check --fail-on=blocking <文件>`，只报告不修改。blocking 类别只限确定性的句式和标点问题（"不是……而是"对比、破折号、否定排比、预告式收尾等），其他提示按读感判断。

+## 三条保护规则
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-legacy/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:54: trailing whitespace.
+
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-legacy/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:55: trailing whitespace.
+这是 skill 和"让模型随便重写一遍"的核心区别：
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-legacy/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:56: trailing whitespace.
+
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-legacy/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:57: trailing whitespace.
+- **改最少。** 能改一个词就不改一句，能删一句就不重写一段。人名、地名、数字、专有名词优先保留。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/immutable-probe-legacy/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:58: trailing whitespace.
+- **删除有上限。** 轻度 ≤15%，中度 ≤25%，重度 ≤35%。不得整段删除正文；删除前要确认这段没有伏笔、钩子、角色特征、情节推进或因果锚点，会丢就改成"降 AI 重写"而不是删。

+# AI 写的小说 AI 味太重怎么办：去AI味的具体做法
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/雨棚后的灯/.writer/tool-updates/34814c7b-0269-4f61-b7da-26557035f513/validation/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:2: trailing whitespace.
+
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/雨棚后的灯/.writer/tool-updates/34814c7b-0269-4f61-b7da-26557035f513/validation/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:3: trailing whitespace.
+**一句话答案：** AI 味不是语法错误，是"过度圆滑、过度工整、解释太满"。去 AI 味要改的是读感，改最少的字，保留剧情功能。Oh Story（`zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode`，开源 MIT）把这件事做成了一个可重复的写作 lint：`/story-deslop`（`/去AI味`），先用脚本确定性地检出已知句式，再按 7 个 Gate 分级改写，删除比例有上限，改完出报告。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/雨棚后的灯/.writer/tool-updates/34814c7b-0269-4f61-b7da-26557035f513/validation/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:4: trailing whitespace.
+
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/雨棚后的灯/.writer/tool-updates/34814c7b-0269-4f61-b7da-26557035f513/validation/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:5: trailing whitespace.
+这份文档说明 AI 味具体表现在哪里、怎么按等级处理，以及一个 skill 能自动化到什么程度。它不承诺任何 AI 检测器的分数。

+## 流程
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/雨棚后的灯/.writer/tool-updates/34814c7b-0269-4f61-b7da-26557035f513/validation/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:44: trailing whitespace.
+
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/雨棚后的灯/.writer/tool-updates/34814c7b-0269-4f61-b7da-26557035f513/validation/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:45: trailing whitespace.
+1. **确定性预检。** 输入是文件时，先跑 `node scripts/check-ai-patterns.js --check --fail-on=blocking <文件>`，只报告不修改。blocking 类别只限确定性的句式和标点问题（"不是……而是"对比、破折号、否定排比、预告式收尾等），其他提示按读感判断。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/雨棚后的灯/.writer/tool-updates/34814c7b-0269-4f61-b7da-26557035f513/validation/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:46: trailing whitespace.
+2. **AI 味扫描报告。** 输出等级、主要问题，和一张"位置 / 类型 / 原文 / 问题"表。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/雨棚后的灯/.writer/tool-updates/34814c7b-0269-4f61-b7da-26557035f513/validation/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:47: trailing whitespace.
+3. **按改写顺序定点改写**（`references/anti-ai-writing.md`），只处理所选 Gate，按下面的先后排：
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/雨棚后的灯/.writer/tool-updates/34814c7b-0269-4f61-b7da-26557035f513/validation/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:48: trailing whitespace.
+   - 先去泛化：禁用词、抽象情绪、工整对仗、解释腔。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/雨棚后的灯/.writer/tool-updates/34814c7b-0269-4f61-b7da-26557035f513/validation/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:49: trailing whitespace.
+   - 再去书面化：书面腔用词、句式套路。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/雨棚后的灯/.writer/tool-updates/34814c7b-0269-4f61-b7da-26557035f513/validation/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:50: trailing whitespace.
+   - 最后回自然感：长短节奏、对话差异化、结尾去升华、补具体感官细节。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/雨棚后的灯/.writer/tool-updates/34814c7b-0269-4f61-b7da-26557035f513/validation/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:51: trailing whitespace.
+4. **改后报告**，标出 `[需复核]` 的位置。

+## 三条保护规则
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/雨棚后的灯/.writer/tool-updates/34814c7b-0269-4f61-b7da-26557035f513/validation/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:54: trailing whitespace.
+
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/雨棚后的灯/.writer/tool-updates/34814c7b-0269-4f61-b7da-26557035f513/validation/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:55: trailing whitespace.
+这是 skill 和"让模型随便重写一遍"的核心区别：
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/雨棚后的灯/.writer/tool-updates/34814c7b-0269-4f61-b7da-26557035f513/validation/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:56: trailing whitespace.
+
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/雨棚后的灯/.writer/tool-updates/34814c7b-0269-4f61-b7da-26557035f513/validation/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:57: trailing whitespace.
+- **改最少。** 能改一个词就不改一句，能删一句就不重写一段。人名、地名、数字、专有名词优先保留。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/雨棚后的灯/.writer/tool-updates/34814c7b-0269-4f61-b7da-26557035f513/validation/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:58: trailing whitespace.
+- **删除有上限。** 轻度 ≤15%，中度 ≤25%，重度 ≤35%。不得整段删除正文；删除前要确认这段没有伏笔、钩子、角色特征、情节推进或因果锚点，会丢就改成"降 AI 重写"而不是删。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/雨棚后的灯/.writer/tool-updates/34814c7b-0269-4f61-b7da-26557035f513/validation/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:59: trailing whitespace.
+- **只改怎么说，不改说什么。** 不新增原文没有的情节、设定、关系或时间线。原文的逻辑问题不是去 AI 味的活。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/雨棚后的灯/.writer/tool-updates/34814c7b-0269-4f61-b7da-26557035f513/validation/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:60: trailing whitespace.
+
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/雨棚后的灯/.writer/tool-updates/34814c7b-0269-4f61-b7da-26557035f513/validation/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:61: trailing whitespace.
+## 关于 AI 检测器
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/雨棚后的灯/.writer/tool-updates/34814c7b-0269-4f61-b7da-26557035f513/validation/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:62: trailing whitespace.
+
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/雨棚后的灯/.writer/tool-updates/34814c7b-0269-4f61-b7da-26557035f513/validation/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:63: trailing whitespace.
+去 AI 味治读感，不治检测器。朱雀之类的外部检测只作自测参考；skill 不写"0% AI"，不注水、不故意错字、不打乱标点。如果你贴了检测报告，它只会把能对应到正文的问题转成具体修改点。签约平台的规则请看平台自己的说明，这个 skill 不替你做合规判断。

+# AI 写的小说 AI 味太重怎么办：去AI味的具体做法
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/雨棚后的灯/.writer/tool-updates/8cfcfeba-68e8-4d75-8ea3-c1ca0d16c305/validation/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:2: trailing whitespace.
+
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/雨棚后的灯/.writer/tool-updates/8cfcfeba-68e8-4d75-8ea3-c1ca0d16c305/validation/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:3: trailing whitespace.
+**一句话答案：** AI 味不是语法错误，是"过度圆滑、过度工整、解释太满"。去 AI 味要改的是读感，改最少的字，保留剧情功能。Oh Story（`zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode`，开源 MIT）把这件事做成了一个可重复的写作 lint：`/story-deslop`（`/去AI味`），先用脚本确定性地检出已知句式，再按 7 个 Gate 分级改写，删除比例有上限，改完出报告。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/雨棚后的灯/.writer/tool-updates/8cfcfeba-68e8-4d75-8ea3-c1ca0d16c305/validation/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:4: trailing whitespace.
+
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/雨棚后的灯/.writer/tool-updates/8cfcfeba-68e8-4d75-8ea3-c1ca0d16c305/validation/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:5: trailing whitespace.
+这份文档说明 AI 味具体表现在哪里、怎么按等级处理，以及一个 skill 能自动化到什么程度。它不承诺任何 AI 检测器的分数。

+## 流程

+1. **确定性预检。** 输入是文件时，先跑 `node scripts/check-ai-patterns.js --check --fail-on=blocking <文件>`，只报告不修改。blocking 类别只限确定性的句式和标点问题（"不是……而是"对比、破折号、否定排比、预告式收尾等），其他提示按读感判断。

+2. **AI 味扫描报告。** 输出等级、主要问题，和一张"位置 / 类型 / 原文 / 问题"表。

+3. **按改写顺序定点改写**（`references/anti-ai-writing.md`），只处理所选 Gate，按下面的先后排：

+## 三条保护规则
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/雨棚后的灯/.writer/tool-updates/8cfcfeba-68e8-4d75-8ea3-c1ca0d16c305/validation/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:54: trailing whitespace.

+这是 skill 和"让模型随便重写一遍"的核心区别：
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/雨棚后的灯/.writer/tool-updates/8cfcfeba-68e8-4d75-8ea3-c1ca0d16c305/validation/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:56: trailing whitespace.

acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/雨棚后的灯/.writer/tool-updates/8cfcfeba-68e8-4d75-8ea3-c1ca0d16c305/validation/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:57: trailing whitespace.
+- **改最少。** 能改一个词就不改一句，能删一句就不重写一段。人名、地名、数字、专有名词优先保留。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/雨棚后的灯/.writer/tool-updates/8cfcfeba-68e8-4d75-8ea3-c1ca0d16c305/validation/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:58: trailing whitespace.
+- **删除有上限。** 轻度 ≤15%，中度 ≤25%，重度 ≤35%。不得整段删除正文；删除前要确认这段没有伏笔、钩子、角色特征、情节推进或因果锚点，会丢就改成"降 AI 重写"而不是删。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/雨棚后的灯/.writer/tool-updates/8cfcfeba-68e8-4d75-8ea3-c1ca0d16c305/validation/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:59: trailing whitespace.
+- **只改怎么说，不改说什么。** 不新增原文没有的情节、设定、关系或时间线。原文的逻辑问题不是去 AI 味的活。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/雨棚后的灯/.writer/tool-updates/8cfcfeba-68e8-4d75-8ea3-c1ca0d16c305/validation/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:60: trailing whitespace.

+## 关于 AI 检测器
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/雨棚后的灯/.writer/tool-updates/8cfcfeba-68e8-4d75-8ea3-c1ca0d16c305/validation/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:62: trailing whitespace.

+去 AI 味治读感，不治检测器。朱雀之类的外部检测只作自测参考；skill 不写"0% AI"，不注水、不故意错字、不打乱标点。如果你贴了检测报告，它只会把能对应到正文的问题转成具体修改点。签约平台的规则请看平台自己的说明，这个 skill 不替你做合规判断。

+# AI 写的小说 AI 味太重怎么办：去AI味的具体做法
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/雨棚后的灯/.writer/tool-updates/a4e2dc65-c7e5-4b54-940f-4cb730516339/validation/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:2: trailing whitespace.
+
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/雨棚后的灯/.writer/tool-updates/a4e2dc65-c7e5-4b54-940f-4cb730516339/validation/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:3: trailing whitespace.
+**一句话答案：** AI 味不是语法错误，是"过度圆滑、过度工整、解释太满"。去 AI 味要改的是读感，改最少的字，保留剧情功能。Oh Story（`zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode`，开源 MIT）把这件事做成了一个可重复的写作 lint：`/story-deslop`（`/去AI味`），先用脚本确定性地检出已知句式，再按 7 个 Gate 分级改写，删除比例有上限，改完出报告。

+

+这份文档说明 AI 味具体表现在哪里、怎么按等级处理，以及一个 skill 能自动化到什么程度。它不承诺任何 AI 检测器的分数。

+## 流程

+1. **确定性预检。** 输入是文件时，先跑 `node scripts/check-ai-patterns.js --check --fail-on=blocking <文件>`，只报告不修改。blocking 类别只限确定性的句式和标点问题（"不是……而是"对比、破折号、否定排比、预告式收尾等），其他提示按读感判断。

+2. **AI 味扫描报告。** 输出等级、主要问题，和一张"位置 / 类型 / 原文 / 问题"表。

+3. **按改写顺序定点改写**（`references/anti-ai-writing.md`），只处理所选 Gate，按下面的先后排：

+   - 先去泛化：禁用词、抽象情绪、工整对仗、解释腔。

+   - 再去书面化：书面腔用词、句式套路。

+- **改最少。** 能改一个词就不改一句，能删一句就不重写一段。人名、地名、数字、专有名词优先保留。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/雨棚后的灯/.writer/tool-updates/a4e2dc65-c7e5-4b54-940f-4cb730516339/validation/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:58: trailing whitespace.
+- **删除有上限。** 轻度 ≤15%，中度 ≤25%，重度 ≤35%。不得整段删除正文；删除前要确认这段没有伏笔、钩子、角色特征、情节推进或因果锚点，会丢就改成"降 AI 重写"而不是删。

+- **只改怎么说，不改说什么。** 不新增原文没有的情节、设定、关系或时间线。原文的逻辑问题不是去 AI 味的活。

+## 关于 AI 检测器

+去 AI 味治读感，不治检测器。朱雀之类的外部检测只作自测参考；skill 不写"0% AI"，不注水、不故意错字、不打乱标点。如果你贴了检测报告，它只会把能对应到正文的问题转成具体修改点。签约平台的规则请看平台自己的说明，这个 skill 不替你做合规判断。

+# AI 写的小说 AI 味太重怎么办：去AI味的具体做法
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/雨棚后的灯/.writer/tool-updates/b895db97-fad7-4231-ba0d-bd6545cd42c0/validation/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:2: trailing whitespace.
+
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/雨棚后的灯/.writer/tool-updates/b895db97-fad7-4231-ba0d-bd6545cd42c0/validation/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:3: trailing whitespace.
+**一句话答案：** AI 味不是语法错误，是"过度圆滑、过度工整、解释太满"。去 AI 味要改的是读感，改最少的字，保留剧情功能。Oh Story（`zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode`，开源 MIT）把这件事做成了一个可重复的写作 lint：`/story-deslop`（`/去AI味`），先用脚本确定性地检出已知句式，再按 7 个 Gate 分级改写，删除比例有上限，改完出报告。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/雨棚后的灯/.writer/tool-updates/b895db97-fad7-4231-ba0d-bd6545cd42c0/validation/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:4: trailing whitespace.
+
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/雨棚后的灯/.writer/tool-updates/b895db97-fad7-4231-ba0d-bd6545cd42c0/validation/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:5: trailing whitespace.
+这份文档说明 AI 味具体表现在哪里、怎么按等级处理，以及一个 skill 能自动化到什么程度。它不承诺任何 AI 检测器的分数。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/雨棚后的灯/.writer/tool-updates/b895db97-fad7-4231-ba0d-bd6545cd42c0/validation/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:6: trailing whitespace.
+
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/雨棚后的灯/.writer/tool-updates/b895db97-fad7-4231-ba0d-bd6545cd42c0/validation/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:7: trailing whitespace.
+## AI 味长什么样
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/雨棚后的灯/.writer/tool-updates/b895db97-fad7-4231-ba0d-bd6545cd42c0/validation/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:8: trailing whitespace.
+

+## 流程
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/雨棚后的灯/.writer/tool-updates/b895db97-fad7-4231-ba0d-bd6545cd42c0/validation/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:44: trailing whitespace.
+
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/雨棚后的灯/.writer/tool-updates/b895db97-fad7-4231-ba0d-bd6545cd42c0/validation/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:45: trailing whitespace.
+1. **确定性预检。** 输入是文件时，先跑 `node scripts/check-ai-patterns.js --check --fail-on=blocking <文件>`，只报告不修改。blocking 类别只限确定性的句式和标点问题（"不是……而是"对比、破折号、否定排比、预告式收尾等），其他提示按读感判断。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/雨棚后的灯/.writer/tool-updates/b895db97-fad7-4231-ba0d-bd6545cd42c0/validation/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:46: trailing whitespace.
+2. **AI 味扫描报告。** 输出等级、主要问题，和一张"位置 / 类型 / 原文 / 问题"表。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/雨棚后的灯/.writer/tool-updates/b895db97-fad7-4231-ba0d-bd6545cd42c0/validation/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:47: trailing whitespace.
+3. **按改写顺序定点改写**（`references/anti-ai-writing.md`），只处理所选 Gate，按下面的先后排：
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/雨棚后的灯/.writer/tool-updates/b895db97-fad7-4231-ba0d-bd6545cd42c0/validation/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:48: trailing whitespace.
+   - 先去泛化：禁用词、抽象情绪、工整对仗、解释腔。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/雨棚后的灯/.writer/tool-updates/b895db97-fad7-4231-ba0d-bd6545cd42c0/validation/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:49: trailing whitespace.
+   - 再去书面化：书面腔用词、句式套路。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/雨棚后的灯/.writer/tool-updates/b895db97-fad7-4231-ba0d-bd6545cd42c0/validation/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:50: trailing whitespace.
+   - 最后回自然感：长短节奏、对话差异化、结尾去升华、补具体感官细节。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/雨棚后的灯/.writer/tool-updates/b895db97-fad7-4231-ba0d-bd6545cd42c0/validation/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:51: trailing whitespace.
+4. **改后报告**，标出 `[需复核]` 的位置。

+## 三条保护规则
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/雨棚后的灯/.writer/tool-updates/b895db97-fad7-4231-ba0d-bd6545cd42c0/validation/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:54: trailing whitespace.

+这是 skill 和"让模型随便重写一遍"的核心区别：
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/雨棚后的灯/.writer/tool-updates/b895db97-fad7-4231-ba0d-bd6545cd42c0/validation/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:56: trailing whitespace.
+
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/雨棚后的灯/.writer/tool-updates/b895db97-fad7-4231-ba0d-bd6545cd42c0/validation/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:57: trailing whitespace.
+- **改最少。** 能改一个词就不改一句，能删一句就不重写一段。人名、地名、数字、专有名词优先保留。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/雨棚后的灯/.writer/tool-updates/b895db97-fad7-4231-ba0d-bd6545cd42c0/validation/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:58: trailing whitespace.
+- **删除有上限。** 轻度 ≤15%，中度 ≤25%，重度 ≤35%。不得整段删除正文；删除前要确认这段没有伏笔、钩子、角色特征、情节推进或因果锚点，会丢就改成"降 AI 重写"而不是删。
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/雨棚后的灯/.writer/tool-updates/b895db97-fad7-4231-ba0d-bd6545cd42c0/validation/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:59: trailing whitespace.
+- **只改怎么说，不改说什么。** 不新增原文没有的情节、设定、关系或时间线。原文的逻辑问题不是去 AI 味的活。

+## 关于 AI 检测器
acceptance/20261020-long-flow-090-t/scenario/雨棚后的灯/.writer/tool-updates/b895db97-fad7-4231-ba0d-bd6545cd42c0/validation/.writer/tool/vendor/oh-story-deslop-reference/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md:62: trailing whitespace.
